newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar Diamond sells 8 stores in Colorado.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar Diamond sells 8 stores in Colorado.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp said it sold eight convenience stores with gas stations in Colorado to Petro-Mark Convenience Stores Inc, a subsidiary of Wescourt Group Inc.
The outlets are Corner Stores that sell Diamond Shamrock brand gasoline. Terms of the sale were not discloed.
The stores will continue to sell Diamond Shamrock gas.

"The addition of Petro-Mark as a marketer will maintain and ultimately enhance Diamond Shamrock's brand presence along Colorado's Western Slope," said Robert Beadle, Ultramar Diamond Shamrock's senior vice president, retail marketing. "We are proud to have Petro-Mark fly our flag as well as purchase and operate these stores."

Beadle said the company will continue to have a strong presence in Colorado. The sale brings the number of Diamond Shamrock company-operated Corner Stores in Colorado to 121, with 52 additional Diamond Shamrock branded outlets in the state.
